fault_desc: unlogged wrong port, then benign payment release
diagnosis: Payment deployment was updated to version 1.8.3 at 18:35:46, 4 seconds before alert. Checkout service depends on payment service (PAYMENT_ADDR=payment:9999). The new payment version may have introduced a breaking change or bug causing checkout to fail with HTTP 500 errors, then timeouts as payment service became unresponsive. Checkout pod is healthy but cannot communicate with payment service.
